decision: Official OEM / manufacturer / Egypt importer-distributor photos and brand logos are approved for use on CarIndex.
accept_rules: source is an official OEM, manufacturer press/media site, or the Egypt importer/distributor (site, brochure, press kit)
exact brand + model verified visually; generation consistent with the model years on sale in Egypt
no other vehicle substituted; no synthetic or edited imagery; no third-party watermark
hero: full vehicle, >=1600 px wide preferred (>=1200 px minimum, flagged LOW_RES below 1600)
source URL, retrieval time, SHA-256 and rights basis stored per asset

decisions.decision: Official manufacturer configurator renders approved for Geely EX2 and EX5 only (geelyeg.com configurator assets), after P2 verifies source, model identity and placement. Not an authorization for AI-generated or arbitrary synthetic images.
decisions.also: Right-hand-drive imagery is not acceptable; a cabin image is accepted only when clearly left-hand drive.
